title: Find your electorate
summary: Find information about your elected representatives by locating your state, federal, or local council electorate.
intro: When you find your state or federal electorate or local council you can get information about your elected representatives.

more_info.text: Find out more about voting and elections.

faqs.q: How do I find my NSW electorate?
faqs.a: Go to the NSW Electoral Commission website, enter your full home address (including street number, street name, and suburb), and select 'Find'.

faqs.q: How do I find my Federal electorate?
faqs.a: Go to the Australian Electoral Commission website, enter your suburb or locality, select 'Locality or suburb' from the drop-down menu, and select 'Find'.

faqs.q: How do I find my local council?
faqs.a: Go to the Office of Local Government website and enter your address.
